    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestBuild" targetRef="ManualTask_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="ManualTask_BuildHouse" targetRef="SendTask_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="Task_BuySnacks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_BuySnacks" targetRef="EndEvent_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_BuildingHouse" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/building-a-tree-house">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BuildingHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree House Architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Stores" name="Online Stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequirementsToArchitect" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DraftFromArchitect" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="CatchEvent_DraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalToArchitect" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAdditional" targetRef="Participant_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedFromArchitect" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="CatchEvent_RevisedReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrdersToStores" sourceRef="UserTask_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Participant_Stores"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequestToFriends" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestBuild" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InvitationsToFriends" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Building a Tree House" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_WantTreeHouse" name="Want to build tree house">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_DraftReceived" name="Draft received from architect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DraftReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefineMerge" name="Draft to refine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraft" name="Refine draft">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefineSplit" name="Further refinements needed?" default="Flow_RefineNo">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefineYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefineNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAdditional" name="Send additional requirements to architect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefineYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_RevisedReceived" name="Revised draft received from architect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RevisedReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterials" name="Create list of needed materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefineNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderSplit" name="Split order and build requests">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_PlaceOrders" name="Order materials from several online stores">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RequestBuild" name="Send build requests to friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderJoin" name="Orders and requests sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_BuildHouse" name="Build tree house">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendInvitations" name="Send tree house party invitations to friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of attending people">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuySnacks" name="Buy snacks for party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PartyPrepared" name="Party prepared">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_WantTreeHouse" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="CatchEvent_DraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="CatchEvent_DraftReceived" targetRef="Gateway_RefineMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_RefineMerge" targetRef="Task_RefineDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraft" targetRef="Gateway_RefineSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefineYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefineSplit" targetRef="SendTask_SendAdditional"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefineNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefineSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAdditional" targetRef="CatchEvent_RevisedReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="CatchEvent_RevisedReceived" targetRef="Gateway_RefineMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_OrderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderSplit" targetRef="UserTask_PlaceOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderSplit" targetRef="SendTask_RequestBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="UserTask_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Gateway_OrderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestBuild" targetRef="Gateway_OrderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderJoin" targetRef="ManualTask_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="ManualTask_BuildHouse" targetRef="SendTask_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="Task_BuySnacks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_BuySnacks" targetRef="EndEvent_PartyPrepared"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
